info.name: ShopVerse REST Learning API
info.description: Synthetic local API. Read each request prerequisite; this is not a sequential all-requests collection runner. Reset data as needed. The test script only checks for server errors; a 4xx may be an intended exercise failure.

request.description:
Filter by name, category, or availability. Results default to NAME_ASC and use offset pagination.

Use the seed dataset or adjust IDs to match your current local data. Writes may affect later examples.

exec: pm.test("Response is not a server error", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

request.description:

request.description:
Create an ACTIVE cart for the authenticated customer. No request body is required.

Use the seed dataset or adjust IDs to match your current local data. Writes may affect later examples.

request.description:
Return the cart. ACTIVE totals use current catalogue prices; CHECKED_OUT carts retain the checkout snapshot. Totals exclude shipping and tax. Owners and administrators may inspect the cart.

Use the seed dataset or adjust IDs to match your current local data. Writes may affect later examples.

exec: pm.test("Response is not a server error", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

item.name: Add a product to a cart [addCartItem]

request.description:
Only ACTIVE carts accept changes. Quantity is 1-99, availability must be IN_STOCK, and at most 10 distinct products are allowed. Update an existing item instead of adding it again.

Use an ACTIVE cart that does not already contain this product. The seed cart is empty after reset.

exec: pm.test("Response is not a server error", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); const item = data.items.find(x => x.productId === 'prod_1001'); if (item) pm.environment.set('itemId', item.id); }

request.description:
Replace the quantity, rather than incrementing it. Quantity zero is invalid; use DELETE to remove an item.

After reset, add prod_1001 to cart_1001 once and use the returned item ID.

exec: pm.test("Response is not a server error", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

item.name: Remove an item from a cart [removeCartItem]

request.description:
Remove one item from an ACTIVE cart and return the updated cart. A second deletion returns 404.

After reset, add prod_1001 to cart_1001 once and use the returned item ID.

exec: pm.test("Response is not a server error", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

request.description:
Create an order from your nonempty ACTIVE cart. Send Idempotency-Key. A successful order snapshots item prices and closes the cart. No payment, tax, shipping charge, or stock reservation is performed.

After reset, add an available product to cart_1001 before placing an order. Preserve the same key and details for retries.

exec: pm.test("Response is not a server error", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.id) pm.environment.set('orderId', data.id); }
